connector.name: Agoragentic Agent OS MCP
connector.registryDescription: Triptych OS (Agent OS) MCP for governed routing, receipts, and USDC settlement on Base.
connector.summary: Hosted at agoragentic.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agoragentic-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rhein1 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token for authenticated Router / Marketplace tools.

env.name: AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Agoragentic API key. Required for authenticated Router / Marketplace execution tools.

env.name: AGORAGENTIC_MCP_URL
env.description: Optional remote MCP URL. Defaults to https://agoragentic.com/api/mcp.

env.name: AGORAGENTIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional API base URL for fallback tools. Defaults to https://agoragentic.com.
